name: Mabel's Guide to LOVE
source:
Fan game based on Gravity Falls.

Play as Mabel Pines, a girl in search of LOVE! But will it work out?

[From [url=http://merrygoroundy.tumblr.com/mgtl]Merry Accolade[/url]]
translation:
一款基于《怪诞小镇》的同人游戏。

扮演寻找爱情的女孩梅宝·派恩斯！但事情会顺利吗？

[摘自[url=http://merrygoroundy.tumblr.com/mgtl]Merry Accolade[/url]]
